unit.title: Ourselves
unit.blurb: The parts of the human body and our five senses: seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting and touching.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Name the main parts of the human body.

O2.t: Know the five senses and the body part used for each.

p: We all have a **head**, two **arms**, two **hands**, two **legs** and two **feet**. Our arms bend at the **elbows** and our legs bend at the **knees**.
Many body parts come in twos: two eyes, two ears, two arms, two legs.

p: We find out about the world with our **senses**. We **see** with our eyes, **hear** with our ears, **smell** with our nose, **taste** with our tongue and **touch** with our skin.

lesson.q: How can you tell an orange is an orange, with your eyes closed?
lesson.a: You can use smell, touch and taste.

q.prompt: Which body part do you use to hear?
You eat a lemon. Which sense tells you it is sour?

req.prompt: Match each sense to the body part.
req.reason: touch – skin; see – eyes; hear – ears.
